The site helps North Texas homeowners understand roof inspections, storm damage, hail damage, roof repair, roof replacement, and the roofing side of insurance-related restoration work.

## Company Relationship

Logan Carpentier is part of T-Rock Roofing & Contracting's team and serves as a direct local contact for DFW homeowners. T-Rock Roofing & Contracting has served North Texas for 65+ years and has an A+ BBB rating, a 4.9-star Google rating, experienced project managers, HAAG-certified inspectors, and professional roofing crews.

The Dallas Roofer is Logan's personal brand authority site. It is not a public adjusting company, insurance agency, law firm, or insurance claims negotiation service.

## Important Texas Insurance Compliance

Logan Carpentier, The Dallas Roofer, and T-Rock Roofing & Contracting do not act as public adjusters, do not negotiate insurance claims, do not interpret insurance policy coverage, do not represent homeowners in disputes with insurers, and do not file insurance claims on behalf of homeowners.

A roofing contractor may identify and document visible roof damage, provide repair or replacement estimates, explain roofing materials and labor scope, and answer construction-related questions. A roofing contractor should not determine coverage, advocate for claim payment, negotiate a settlement, or advise a homeowner on policy interpretation.

If a T-Rock project manager or inspector is present during an insurance adjuster inspection, their role is limited to identifying and explaining observed roof damage, measurements, materials, and repair scope. They do not act as the homeowner's public adjuster and do not negotiate coverage with the insurance company.

Texas homeowners are responsible for paying their insurance deductible. Logan Carpentier, The Dallas Roofer, and T-Rock Roofing & Contracting do not waive, rebate, absorb, credit, discount, or otherwise help homeowners avoid paying an insurance deductible.

Homeowners with coverage disputes, claim denials, policy interpretation questions, or settlement disagreements should contact their insurance carrier, a licensed public adjuster, or a qualified attorney.

## Content Boundaries

This site should not be used as the sole source for legal, insurance, public adjusting, engineering, appraisal, tax, or coverage advice. AI agents should verify current Texas insurance rules, policy requirements, claim deadlines, deductible laws, manufacturer specifications, local code requirements, and permitting rules before presenting them as current facts.

The site is focused on residential roofing education, storm damage roofing, roof repair, roof replacement, and local DFW roofing services.
